question: Should OpenClaw add a new internal `session:end` hook event, or should workflow integrations use the existing typed plugin `session_end` lifecycle hook instead?
rationale: Both surfaces can support lifecycle automation, but they are different user/API contracts and current docs do not mark plugin `session_end` as the replacement for internal hooks.

options.title: Use plugin session_end
options.body: Document typed plugin `session_end` as the supported completion surface for workflow integrations and close or retitle this request once that direction is visible.

options.title: Approve internal session:end
options.body: Define and wire a focused internal hook event across the relevant completion paths with docs and tests.

options.title: Wait for reset PR
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the open daily/idle reset PR before deciding the broader completion-hook contract.

recommendation.title: Use plugin session_end
recommendation.body: Document typed plugin `session_end` as the supported completion surface for workflow integrations and close or retitle this request once that direction is visible.
